rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise file, not article

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a reference artifact

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
Watch out for planting jargon too early.
Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a body prose trim case

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL — default is to omit it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Block correctly omitted per default

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file scope; cross-file binding is architectural

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Judging artifact, not authoring session

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
Earn every technical term on first use.
Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 content; Agents 101 rule does not apply

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION; read to the boundary before cutting anything.
Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Pedagogical exercise instruction, not prompt design

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No retro interview structure in this exercise

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Reading-for-understanding (plan quality review) not error-catching by comparison; dialogue-based refinement throughout

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No simulation personas in this file

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All student actions routed through agent conversation (ask Claude, plan mode, approval prompt, dialogue)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File does not reference CLAUDE.md editing

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers: Bring, Enter, Push back, Walk down, Stop/name — all command verbs for action sections

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No cross-file inline links present

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Correct usage: 'agent' for autonomous work, 'Claude' for addressee (Ask Claude) and UI reference

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session / task / run split (all trainings).
No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phase 5 reflection labeled as task (name the pattern) not as reflection announcement

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
.md is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Notice X lines appear before plan is produced (during scan phase), not after chat-print

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No forward-callout closers in this file

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
Name the artifact, not the act.
Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
The curriculum does not narrate itself — subject test, then deletion test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No self-narration of curriculum shape or arc positioning

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No placeholders inside fences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompts use markers {{prompt:...}} at build time; no inline brackets

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Prompts live in registry; module/exercise/lecture files reference by marker.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All five prompts use markers ({{prompt:push-back-on-the-plan-1}} through -3); no inline **Prompt** blocks

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise file has no Big Idea or mood statement; mood contract belongs to module file
